badges.detail: PAR2 create, 1 GiB / 1024 slices (1 MiB), R=8; native Windows. GFNI+AVX-512 reference; pow2 slice count for direct PAR3 comparison. Median of 8 back-to-back runs, stdev 6.6 (1.1%)
PAR3 create, 1 GiB / 1024 slices (1 MiB), R=8, Fenger kernel (pow2 slices + pow2 recovery, post-#87); native Windows. Median of 5 runs, stdev 1.18 (1.9%)
PAR2 create, 1 GiB / 32768 slices (32 KiB), R=8; native Windows. PAR2's GFNI+AVX-512 is the speed reference for the PAR3 rows. Median of 5 back-to-back runs, stdev 9.65 (1.6%)
PAR3 create, 1 GiB / 32768 slices (32 KiB blocks), R=8, Fenger kernel; native Windows. ~24x behind PAR2 at the same shape. Median of 3 measured runs + 1 warmup-discarded, stdev 2.63 (10%)

PAR3 create, 1 GiB / 131072 slices (8 KiB blocks), R=8, Fenger kernel; native Windows. ~36x behind PAR2 at the matching slice-count row. Median of 5 measured runs + 1 warmup, stdev 1.58 (9%). Initial 3-run probe (11.6 MB/s) was a thermal artifact from back-to-back with a hotter prior workload — re-measured after 30 s cooldown.
PAR3 create, 1 GiB / 262144 slices (4 KiB blocks), R=8, Fenger kernel; native Windows. ~34x behind PAR2 at the matching slice-count row. Median of 3 measured runs + 1 warmup, stdev 0.72 (4%)

PAR3 create, 16 GiB / 262144 slices (64 KiB blocks), R=8, Fenger kernel; native Windows. 'Magic shape' (zero padding, Fenger direct, no Barycentric fallback). Wall time on Zen4 ~15-20 min based on 17 MB/s extrapolation from 1G/131k. Replaces the unrunnable 10G/131k/80KiB row (post-#87 pow2 enforcement).
